subject: Island 014 Blender boolean recessed honey cathedral facade first geometry gate

inputs.evidenceIntegrity: All four v004 SVG/JPEG hash pairs match capture-manifest.blender.v1.json; the JPEGs are browser rasterizations of the immutable actual-mesh SVG captures.

reviewPolicy.coverageNote: Remaining orbit, wireframe, normals, materials-on, and phone-overview evidence was deferred by the manifest; the present hard veto is already conclusive at the first geometry gate.

meshBudgetAssessment.finding: Part and triangle budgets pass, but budget compliance does not cure the visible hollow/open assembly.

perViewScores.note: The front can be parsed as a gable, rose, door, four bays, and side buttresses. The doorway is a blank central plane without a readable recessed arch, the rose lacks a dark backplane, and multiple surfaces only appear continuous because this view hides the open depth.

Large background-colored voids open through the gable/door assembly, exposing an unsupported outline and card-like planes. Four bays are not reliably countable, and no credible reveal walls or seated solid shell survive the oblique.
The opposite oblique repeats the open-hole/hollow-card failure, missing recess backs, apparent disconnected facade planes, and loss of four-bay identity.
The close crop confirms a blank doorway plane and shallow disconnected facets rather than a genuinely recessed royal entrance with continuous reveal walls.

criticalFloorEvaluation.finding: Every category's governing score is below the 0.50 critical first-pass floor.

openHoleOrHollowCard.finding: Large clear voids expose the background through the gable and entrance assembly; shell pieces read as outline/card surfaces without enclosed reveal volume.

fewerThanFourCountableBays.finding: Four separate occupied bay openings cannot be reliably identified in either required oblique.

doorHiddenByCentralSlab.finding: A blank central plane replaces the required recessed pointed doorway and legible masonry arch.

unattachedOrNonManifoldHeroShell.present: visual-unattached-read; manifold status not proven without deferred topology evidence
unattachedOrNonManifoldHeroShell.finding: Obliques visibly separate shell/gable elements with open gaps; the materials-off set is sufficient for the unattached visual veto even though normals/manifold audit evidence is deferred.

largestMismatch: The source facade is a dense, solid honey cathedral with deeply seated door, rose, and bay openings. This Blender blockout is only convincing frontally; obliques reveal an open skeletal gable and hollow card assembly with no continuous recess volume or coherent attachment to the host.

correctionDisposition.reason: The hard veto and 0.05 worst score require rebuilding the hero shell, door/rose backplanes, reveal walls, attachments, and bay layout. That is a topology reconstruction, not one bounded correction.

terminalReason: The open-hole/hollow-card hard veto is present, four bays fail both required obliques, the door is replaced by a central slab, and the 0.05 worst score is far below the 0.50 critical first-pass floor. The family is not eligible for a bounded correction.
